findings: Selected V1 _model_forward finally releases metadata executor, not Engram producer; explicit callback prepare failure occurs before that protected try.
V2 EngramModelState.finish_execution explicitly retires Engram and always invokes superclass finish. It is not the selected V1 cleanup path.
Captured slotless helper joins producer on producer/consumer exception, but selected V1 SP/slot-cache route is ineligible for that helper.
Existing producer preparation catches its own auxiliary prepare() error and invokes retire helper; a later model callback failure is a separate boundary.
qualification: Opaque callback failures are source controls, not an observed device race or proof of service recovery policy. No changed primitive, framework integration, live task or NPU evidence.
